points.description: States that a queue is a data structure that stores elements in first in, first out (FIFO) order (the first element added is the first removed). Mentioning enqueue/dequeue is optional.
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks if the answer only names it as a data structure or describes adding/removing elements (e.g. enqueue/dequeue, add at back, remove from front) without clearly giving the first-in-first-out idea.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying a queue is a data structure where the first element in is the first out, in any wording (e.g. "first come first served", "FIFO"). Part marks for a vague or incomplete answer, such as only mentioning enqueue/dequeue or adding at one end and removing at the other, without stating the order. No marks for LIFO/stack descriptions or unrelated content. Missing the operation names costs nothing.
